title: Zemlya Sannikova
writer: Vladislav Fedoseyev, Vladimir Obruchev, Mark Zakharov
actors: Vladislav Dvorzhetskiy, Georgiy Vitsin, Oleg Dal
plot: The exiled settler Alexander Ilyin persuades the goldmines owner Trifon Perfilyev to sponsor the expedition dedicated to the searches of "Sannikov Land", a legendary warm land behind the Polar circle.
